highlights.quote: The historian's task begins before counting bodies. It begins by asking who named the act, who recorded it, and what followed from the name.
highlights.judgment: Crisp statement of the governing method; the book earns it repeatedly rather than asserting it once.

highlights.quote: A healed fracture has a rounded, remodelled edge: bone has had time to lay down new tissue and smooth the break. An unhealed fracture retains the sharpness and irregularity of a recent wound.
highlights.judgment: Genuine technical specificity — the reader is taught how the inference works, not just told its result.

highlights.quote: The absence of a trace cannot be assigned a meaning until the processes that might have erased it are known.
highlights.judgment: Best expression of the book's epistemic discipline about silence in the record.

highlights.quote: That sentence is chilling because its grammar leaves a human subject in place while removing a human future.
highlights.judgment: Rare moment where close reading of language does real analytic work; the Wannsee chapter is the strongest prose in the book.

highlights.quote: A military bureaucracy did not eliminate interruption. It made interruption assignable.
highlights.judgment: Sharp and true, but it is the hundredth instance of the same 'not X; it Y-ed' cadence, so its force is spent by arrival.

highlights.quote: At Tophane, aggression acquired an office address.
highlights.judgment: Aphoristic section-closer of a kind that terminates nearly every unit in the book; individually neat, cumulatively formulaic.

highlights.quote: Offices decided how the danger was distributed.
highlights.judgment: The thesis restated as a standalone one-line paragraph — a beat marker the book uses so often it stops registering as emphasis.

highlights.quote: Neither society fits a peaceful-versus-warlike opposition.
highlights.judgment: Typical of the symmetrical hedge that closes most comparisons; the balanced refusal becomes predictable rather than corrective.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Every chapter and nearly every internal section opens with a dated, cinematic cold open ('On [date], at [place]…') before pivoting to a document.
instances: On the morning of 1 September 2004, families in Beslan walked towards School Number One with flowers, schoolbags, and the small formal clothes children wore for the first day of lessons.
On 20 January 1942, Reinhard Heydrich gathered fifteen men at a lakeside villa in Wannsee, a suburb of Berlin, to settle a problem that had already been killing people for years.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Paired antithesis as the default analytic sentence: a negation immediately corrected by the institutional claim ('It did not A. It B-ed.').
instances: The clay was an instrument of memory, but also of supervision.
The paper did not merely describe scarcity. It redistributed it.

recurringPatterns.pattern: A short standalone one-sentence paragraph inserted as an emotional or rhetorical beat, roughly once per section.
instances: A first day of school became a room under guard.
A pregnant woman lay among them.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Sections close on an aphoristic restatement of the same thesis — power routed through offices, records, ledgers — so the argument is re-instantiated rather than advanced.
instances: A clerk's tablet and a soldier's spear therefore belonged to the same growing world. One measured what could be taken; the other enforced the taking.
Technology supplied reach and tempo; offices supplied permission.

recurringPatterns.pattern: Comparisons are resolved by a symmetrical two-sided hedge that declines both extremes, in almost identical grammar across chapters.
instances: This is neither a portrait of natural savagery nor evidence of a peaceful past corrupted at a later date.
The steppe was neither an empty barrier nor a single launching ground for conquest.

summary: This is a disciplined, unusually well-evidenced global history of organised violence, held together by a single strong claim: the scale of aggression is a property of offices, records, categories and supply chains rather than of human temperament. The evidentiary handling is the book's chief strength — it repeatedly explains how an inference is made (perimortem versus postmortem fracture, the murdrum fine, the Wannsee euphemism, entitlement failure in Bengal) and is candid about what its sources cannot establish, including the biases that decide which violence leaves a trace. Prose is clear, controlled and consistent in register, and the chapter sequence from Pleistocene cemeteries to post-1945 deterrence is coherent and well paced at the macro level. The weakness is mechanical repetition at the micro level: every chapter is built to the same template (dated scene, document, comparison, aphoristic institutional closer), and the same three or four sentence shapes — the corrected negation, the standalone one-line beat, the symmetrical two-sided hedge — recur hundreds of times, so that after roughly the fourth chapter the thesis is re-instantiated rather than developed. There is also no real introduction or conclusion apparatus beyond the first and last chapters, and no authorial personality, humour or risk to relieve the uniform sobriety. With a pass that varies chapter architecture, thins the restatements and breaks up the habitual cadences, this would be publishable non-fiction; as it stands the craft is high but the shape is visibly manufactured.
